meta.name: capture
meta.description: Captures and organizes chaotic brain dumps into a structured, actionable system with zero information loss. Use this skill whenever the user says 'capture this', 'brain dump', 'let me dump some ideas', 'I've got a bunch of thoughts', 'here's everything on my mind', 'idea dump', 'let me get this out of my head', 'I need to organize my thoughts', 'here's what I'm thinking', or any variation where someone is unloading a messy stream of ideas, tasks, thoughts, and plans wanting them turned into something coherent. Also trigger when the user pastes or dictates a long, unstructured block of mixed ideas — even without the exact phrase — the intent is the same. Fast-to-action by design: no upfront intake. Output is four sections (Projects/Ideas, Tasks, Connections, How I Can Help) ending with a directive question. Asks at most one mid-organization clarifying question when a single item is genuinely ambiguous between task and project.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的思绪整理成清晰的项目和任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常有零散想法需要快速变成可执行的计划
copy.tagline_en: Turn messy thoughts into structured projects and tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often have scattered ideas that need to become actionable plans

howto.what: 当你把一堆杂乱的想法、任务、计划一股脑倒给Claude时，它会自动整理成四个板块：项目/想法、任务、关联、以及它能如何帮你。最后会问你想先处理哪个。
howto.when: 当你说出“capture this”、“brain dump”、“idea dump”等关键词，或者直接粘贴/口述一大段未整理的内容时触发。

say.text: capture this：我脑子里一堆关于新App的想法，帮我理一下。
say.note: Claude会开始整理并输出四个板块。

say.text: brain dump：今天要做的五件事，还有两个项目点子。
let me dump some ideas：关于旅行、工作和学习的新计划。
say.note: Claude会组织成项目/想法和任务。

howto.what_en: When you dump a messy stream of ideas, tasks, and plans, Claude automatically organizes them into four sections: Projects/Ideas, Tasks, Connections, and How I Can Help. It ends by asking which to tackle first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'capture this', 'brain dump', 'idea dump', or when you paste/dictate a long unstructured block of mixed ideas.

say_en.text: capture this: I have a bunch of ideas for a new app, help me organize them.
say_en.note: Claude will start organizing and output four sections.

say_en.text: brain dump: Five things to do today and two project ideas.
say_en.note: Claude will classify into tasks and projects.

say_en.text: let me dump some ideas: New plans about travel, work, and study.
say_en.note: Claude will organize into projects/ideas and tasks.
